map.按总天数与景点优先级优化旅游时间分配，平衡游玩与休息: Optimize travel time allocation by total days and attraction priority, balancing sightseeing and rest
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：max(minHours, s.hours)；tot: Core formula (from input variables): max(minHours, s.hours); totalHours × 0.15; avgHours × 0.5

map.📚 深度解析：行程时间分配规划: 📚 Deep dive: itinerary time allocation planning
map.自由行前按总天数与每日有效游玩时长，把可用时间按景点优先级（权重）分配，并自动预: Before a free trip, allocate available hours by attraction priority (weights) based on total days and effective daily hours, and auto-reserve meal and rest buffers so the plan is neither too rushed to be a superficial tour nor too loose to waste time.
map.带老人/小孩出行时，降低每日净游玩时长（多留休息），用权重把体力消耗大的景点分散: When traveling with elderly people or children, lower daily net sightseeing hours (leaving more rest) and spread high-exertion attractions by weight to reduce fatigue.
map.多城市中转时，先扣掉交通与入住缓冲，再把剩余天数按城市权重分配，防止某城过赶。: With multi-city transfers, subtract transport and check-in buffers first, then allocate the remaining days by city weight so no single city is rushed.
map.总天数 5、每日有效游玩 8h、每日预留用餐+休息缓冲 3h → 每日净游玩 5: Total days 5, effective sightseeing 8 h/day, 3 h/day reserved for meals and rest → net 5 h/day, total net 25 h. Attraction weights 3:2:1 (total weight 6): A = 25×3/6 ≈ 12.5 h, B = 25×2/6 ≈ 8.3 h, C = 25×1/6 ≈ 4.2 h, i.e. A gets 2.5 days, B 1.7 days, C 0.8 days. If a day includes cross-city transport, subtract the transport time from that day net hours before allocating.
map.缓冲为什么按 3h 估？: Why is the buffer estimated at 3 h?
map.经验值：三餐约 2h + 休息/排队/突发 1h；带娃或老人可提到 4-5h。缓: An empirical value: three meals about 2 h + rest/queue/unexpected 1 h; with children or elderly you can raise it to 4-5 h. The buffer is the deduction in "daily net sightseeing = daily hours - buffer", so increasing it shortens every attraction proportionally.
map.权重怎么定？: How do I set the weights?
map.按「必去/想去/可去」给 3/2/1，或按门票贵重度/唯一性调；权重只影响时长分: Give 3/2/1 for "must see / want to see / optional", or adjust by ticket cost or uniqueness. Weights only affect the proportion of allocated time, not the total available hours.
map.行程时间分配工具，根据总天数、每日游玩时长与景点优先级，按加权方式优化旅游时间分: The Itinerary Time Allocation tool optimizes travel time allocation by weighted priority based on total days, daily sightseeing hours and attraction priority, and reserves buffer time to balance sightseeing and rest.
